items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when Dexter suggested to Bertrand Tavernier that I do the role

ctx.x: Yeah, right, yeah. After it was over, I told Sam – I said “Your recipes really came through,” I said, “because we were eating everything that you suggested.” The way – when Dexter suggested to Bertrand Tavernier that I do the role – what’s the producer’s name, honey, that did Rocky? and – he did all the Rocky movies. I can’t remember his name right now. Anyway, because I had done They Shoot Horses, Don’t They?, he was the producer on that, and when they said, okay, we’ll do . . .
